requiredBehaviors.behavior: inherit the corporate document structure labels and visual context where useful
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Corporate-Template-Inheritance explicitly preserves structure, headings, terminology, organisational set-up blocks, organigram and confidentiality markings.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: replace travel and hybrid placeholders with confirmed values
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Source Reconciliation requires known values to replace placeholders.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: leave genuinely unknown headcount and budget open or remove unnecessary placeholders without inventing values
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Unknown values must not be invented and only genuine unknowns may remain open.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: validate all inherited requirement wording against the current role architecture and scorecard
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The source hierarchy and template rules require historical content to be validated against normative artifacts.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: copy historical requirements merely because they are in the corporate template
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Historical must-haves are explicitly excluded from automatic inheritance.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: retain placeholders for facts already confirmed
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Confirmed facts must replace matching placeholders.
